focus_area_title: Focus on the Customer During Challenging Times
content_text_body:
During times of change and uncertainty employees can lose focus on serving customers, and the impressions left are long-lasting. The goal is to help your team best meet customer needs during challenging times. 

 

### Empathize with the customer 

 

Customers may be struggling too. Help team members treat customers with respect, provide prompt assistance, and not to take the situation personally.  

 

### Provide solutions that best meet customer needs 

 

Help the team be transparent and proactively communicate with customers during challenging situations. Keep in contact with customers to minimize stress.
